view.name: Feeds expanded
view.description: The feed page with two feed disclosures opened, showing dated lists of linked article titles under each feed.

regions.label: Category sections (Developer News, Blogs, Design, Reading & Misc, My GitHub Projects), each a stack of collapsible feeds listing dated headline links
'Errors' section listing feeds that failed to fetch/parse
hr, last-updated timestamp, 'Powered by Bubo Reader' credits and sponsor link

evidence.note: native <details> open by default, revealing dated post list
closed details with ▶ triangle; header shows feed title plus grey feed URL
second open section alongside the first — sections open independently

evidence.quote: 11/15/2026 - Changelog & Friends 118: Kaizen! The one with the new CDN
evidence.note: date + headline link per item, newest first, from subscribed RSS sources

evidence.quote: 11/16/2026 - Quoting a maintainer on why they turned off AI-generated pull requests

patterns.rationale: Content is subscribed RSS headlines in date order, but grouped per source inside disclosures rather than one merged scrolling stream; no loading behaviour.

evidence.quote: There were errors trying to parse these feeds:
evidence.note: unstyled error summary section at end of content

patterns.rationale: Conveys a failure condition but is an unstyled ordinary section at the end of the page, not a visually distinct alert surface.

evidence.note: only one level of disclosure; category headings are not collapsible nodes
headline links go to external sites; no in-app detail view

structure.layout: single-column unstyled HTML document: h1 title, h2 category sections each containing a stack of <details> feed disclosures with dated headline lists, an errors section, hr and footer

aesthetics.typography: system-ui throughout (browser-default sans) for headings, summaries, dates and links
aesthetics.typeScale: browser defaults: h1 36px bold, h2 27px bold, everything else 18px regular; hierarchy only from heading weight/size and grey URL text

notes: Essentially unstyled HTML: default blue (#0000ee) underlined links, default disclosure triangles of <details>/<summary>, bullet lists of 'M/D/YYYY - Title' items, grey (#aaaaaa) feed URLs in parentheses next to each feed name. Only emoji owl in title and ❤️ in footer add visual flavour. Two feeds open by default (Changelog, Simon Willison). Footer shows 'Last updated' build timestamp — a statically generated page. Errors section exposes raw fetch/parse error messages.
